title: What to Know About Bank Melli, Singled Out in U.S. Call for Economic War
summary: Bank Melli, Iran’s largest lender, already faces sanctions that severely limit its ability to operate abroad. Every foreign branch must be shut down, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said.
